intent.proves: Product numbers: number-duplicates satisfies the selected profile assertion.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global.

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT TOP 25 CAST(p.ProductNumber AS nvarchar(100)) FROM EcomProducts p WHERE p.ProductLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND ISNULL(p.ProductNumber, N'') <> N''{inScope} GROUP BY p.ProductNumber HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
